title: PEGL APP front
bodyHtml:
<div id="peg-landing-refresh"><style>
                            #peg-landing-refresh {
                              --peg-ink: #183247;
                              --peg-muted: #5f7382;
                              --peg-line: #d6e2ea;
                              --peg-sky: #eaf6fc;
                              --peg-sky-strong: #cfefff;
                              --peg-teal: #34bced;
                              --peg-navy: #174f7c;
                              --peg-gold: #f3c969;
                              --peg-shell: #fbfdfe;
                              color: var(--peg-ink);
                              font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
                              font-size: 15px;
                              line-height: 1.55;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh * {
                              box-sizing: border-box;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-wrap {
                              max-width: 1120px;
                              margin: 0 auto;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-logos {
                              display: flex;
                              width: 100%;
                              justify-content: center;
                              gap: 50px;
                              margin-bottom: 20px;
                          }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-intro {
                              margin-bottom: 18px;
                              padding: 0 2px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-intro p {
                              margin: 0;
                              color: var(--peg-muted);
                              font-size: 16px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-split {
                              display: grid;
                              grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                              gap: 18px;
                              margin-bottom: 50px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel {
                              position: relative;
                              overflow: hidden;
                              min-height: 320px;
                              padding: 22px 22px 18px 22px;
                              border: 1px solid var(--peg-line);
                              border-radius: 22px;
                              background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f9fcfe 100%);
                              box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(26, 62, 90, 0.06);
                              display: flex;
                              flex-direction: column;
                              justify-content: space-between;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-current {
                              background: white;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-pegasus {
                              background: white;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-tag {
                              display: inline-block;
                              margin-bottom: 12px;
                              padding: 5px 10px;
                              border-radius: 999px;
                              font-size: 11px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                              letter-spacing: 0.08em;
                              text-transform: uppercase;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-tag-current {
                              background: rgba(13, 139, 183, 0.1);
                              color: var(--peg-teal);
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-tag-pegasus {
                              background: rgba(23, 79, 124, 0.1);
                              color: var(--peg-navy);
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-head {
                              display: flex;
                              align-items: flex-start;
                              justify-content: space-between;
                              gap: 16px;
                              margin-bottom: 12px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel h2 {
                              margin: 0 0 10px 0;
                              font-size: 28px;
                              line-height: 1.08;
                              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-title-row {
                              display: flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              gap: 10px;
                              margin: 0 0 10px 0;
                              flex-wrap: wrap;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-title-row h2 {
                              margin: 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-pill-new {
                              display: inline-flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              padding: 4px 10px;
                              border-radius: 999px;
                              background: #e8f6ec;
                              color: #1f7a4d;
                              font-size: 11px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                              letter-spacing: 0.08em;
                              text-transform: uppercase;
                              line-height: 1;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel p {
                              margin: 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-logo {
                              flex: 0 0 auto;
                              width: 50px;
                              height: 50px;
                              object-fit: contain;
                              mix-blend-mode: darken;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-points {
                              margin: 12px 0 14px 0;
                              padding: 0;
                              list-style: none;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-points li {
                              position: relative;
                              margin: 0 0 8px 0;
                              padding-left: 14px;
                              color: var(--peg-ink);
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-points li:before {
                              content: "";
                              position: absolute;
                              left: 0;
                              top: 10px;
                              width: 6px;
                              height: 6px;
                              border-radius: 50%;
                              background: var(--peg-teal);
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-links {
                              display: flex;
                              flex-direction: column;
                              gap: 10px;
                              margin-top: 14px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-links-grid {
                              display: flex;
                              flex-direction: column;
                              gap: 10px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-buttons{
                              display: flex;
                              justify-content: space-between;
                              gap: 5px;
                          }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-button {
                              display: inline-flex;
                              flex-direction: column;
                              flex: 1;
                              width: 100%;
                              justify-content: center;
                              padding: 9px 14px;
                              border-radius: 999px;
                              border: 1px solid var(--peg-teal);
                              background: var(--peg-teal);
                              color: #ffffff !important;
                              font-size: 13px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                              text-decoration: none;
                              text-align: center;
                              white-space: nowrap;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-links-grid .peg-button {
                              display: flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              justify-content: center;
                              min-height: 44px;
                              text-align: center;
                              white-space: nowrap;
                              line-height: 1.2;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-button.alt {
                              background: transparent;
                              color: var(--peg-teal) !important;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-button.disabled {
                              border-color: #c9d7e0;
                              background: #eef3f6;
                              color: #8a9aa6 !important;
                              cursor: default;
                              pointer-events: none;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-soon {
                              display: block;
                              margin-top: 2px;
                              color: inherit;
                              font-size: 12px;
                              font-weight: 400;
                              opacity: 0.85;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-note {
                              margin-top: 14px;
                              padding: 11px 13px;
                              border-left: 4px solid var(--peg-gold);
                              border-radius: 10px;
                              background: #fff9e8;
                              color: #655635;
                              font-size: 13px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-body-grid {
                              display: grid;
                              grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                              gap: 18px;
                              align-items: start;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-column {
                              padding: 2px 0 0 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-column-title {
                              display: flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              gap: 10px;
                              padding-bottom: 10px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-column-title h3 {
                              margin: 0;
                              font-size: 22px;
                              line-height: 1.15;
                              letter-spacing: -0.01em;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-column-kicker {
                              font-size: 11px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                              letter-spacing: 0.08em;
                              text-transform: uppercase;
                              color: var(--peg-muted);
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion {
                              margin-bottom: 10px;
                              border: 1px solid var(--peg-line);
                              border-radius: 16px;
                              background: #ffffff;
                              overflow: hidden;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion > p {
                              margin: 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion button {
                              width: 100%;
                              display: flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              justify-content: space-between;
                              gap: 12px;
                              padding: 14px 16px;
                              border: 0;
                              background: #ffffff;
                              color: var(--peg-ink);
                              text-align: left;
                              cursor: pointer;
                              font-size: 15px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion.is-open button{
                              background: var(--peg-teal);
                              color: white;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion:not(.is-open) button:hover {
                              background: #f8fbfd;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion button .peg-plus {
                              flex: 0 0 auto;
                              width: 24px;
                              height: 24px;
                              border-radius: 999px;
                              background: #eef6fb;
                              color: var(--peg-teal);
                              display: inline-flex;
                              align-items: center;
                              justify-content: center;
                              font-size: 18px;
                              line-height: 1;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion.is-open button .peg-plus {
                              background: var(--peg-teal);
                              color: #ffffff;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel {
                              display: none;
                              padding: 0 16px 16px 16px;
                              border-top: 1px solid #edf2f5;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion.is-open .peg-accordion-panel {
                              display: block;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel p:last-child,
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel ul:last-child {
                              margin-bottom: 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel p {
                              margin: 12px 0 10px 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel ul {
                              margin: 12px 0 10px 18px;
                              padding: 0;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-accordion-panel li {
                              margin-bottom: 6px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-mini-grid {
                              display: grid;
                              grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
                              gap: 10px;
                              margin-top: 12px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-mini-card {
                              padding: 11px 12px;
                              border-radius: 12px;
                              background: #f5fafc;
                              border: 1px solid #e4eef4;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-mini-card strong {
                              display: block;
                              margin-bottom: 4px;
                              color: var(--peg-teal);
                              font-size: 13px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-steps {
                              display: grid;
                              grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
                              gap: 10px;
                              margin-top: 12px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-step {
                              padding: 11px 12px;
                              border-radius: 12px;
                              border: 1px solid #e5eef4;
                              background: #fcfeff;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-step span {
                              display: inline-block;
                              margin-bottom: 5px;
                              color: var(--peg-navy);
                              font-size: 11px;
                              font-weight: 700;
                              letter-spacing: 0.08em;
                              text-transform: uppercase;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-plot-wrap {
                              margin-top: 12px;
                              padding: 12px 12px 2px 12px;
                              border-radius: 14px;
                              background: #fbfdff;
                              border: 1px solid #e3edf3;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-plot-wrap h4 {
                              margin: 0 0 10px 0;
                              font-size: 15px;
                              line-height: 1.3;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-link-row {
                              margin-top: 12px;
                              font-size: 14px;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-link-row a {
                              color: var(--peg-teal);
                              text-decoration: none;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-link-row a:hover {
                              text-decoration: underline;
                            }
                            #peg-landing-refresh .peg-roadmap{
                              width: -webkit-fill-available;
                              padding: 20px;
                          }
                            @media (max-width: 900px) {
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-split,
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-body-grid,
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-mini-grid,
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-steps {
                                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                              }
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel {
                                min-height: auto;
                              }
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-head {
                                flex-direction: column;
                              }
                              #peg-landing-refresh .peg-panel-logo {
                                width: 25px;
                                height: 25px;
                              }
                            }
                          </style><div class="peg-wrap"><div class="peg-split"><section class="peg-panel peg-panel-current"><div class="peg-panel-head"><div class="peg-title-row"><p><img class="peg-panel-logo" src="https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/PEG/PEG_logo_negative.png" alt="PEG icon"></p><h2>PEG</h2><p>The portal currently hosts curated predicted effector gene (PEG) lists drawn from published studies across many traits and disease areas.</p></div></div><p><img class="peg-roadmap" src="http://kp4cd.org/sites/default/files/images/KP_guide_images/EGL_roadmap.png" alt="EGL Roadmap"></p><ul class="peg-points"><li>These are the PEG resources users can explore in the portal today.</li><li>They preserve the formats, evidence structures, and scoring approaches used by their original studies.</li></ul><div class="peg-links"><p><a class="peg-button" style="min-height:52px;" href="/research.html?pageid=egl_241" target="_blank">Explore PEG Lists</a></p><div class="peg-buttons"><a class="peg-button alt" href="/research.html?pageid=egl_tutorial_272" target="_blank">View Tutorial</a> <a class="peg-button alt" href="mailto:help@kp4cd.org">Contact Us</a></div></div></section><section class="peg-panel peg-panel-pegasus"><div class="peg-panel-head"><div><div class="peg-title-row"><p><img class="peg-panel-logo" src="https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/PEG/pegasus_icon.png" alt="PEGASUS icon"></p><h2>PEGASUS</h2><p><span class="peg-pill-new">New</span></p></div><p>Predicted Effector Gene Aggregation, Standards, and Unified Schema (PEGASUS) is a new community framework for organizing and sharing predicted effector gene resources in a more consistent, transparent, and reusable way.</p></div></div><p><img class="peg-roadmap" src="https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/PEG/PEGASUS_steps.png" alt="PEGASUS steps"></p><ul class="peg-points"><li>Designed to support future community submissions and standardized PEG resource sharing.</li><li>Over time, submitted PEG data will become easier to compare, interpret, and reuse.</li></ul><div class="peg-links-grid"><div class="peg-buttons"><a class="peg-button" href="/pegasus.html" target="_blank">Explore PEGASUS Lists</a> <a class="peg-button" href="https://kpndataregistry.org/peg/login/" target="_blank">PEGASUS Data Registry<span class="peg-soon">Submit your data</span></a></div><div class="peg-buttons"><a class="peg-button alt" href="https://gwas-catalog.github.io/PEGASUS/" target="_blank">PEGASUS Documentation</a> <a class="peg-button alt" href="https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.06.16.731894v3" target="_blank">PEGASUS Paper</a></div></div></section></div><div class="peg-body-grid"><section class="peg-column"><div class="peg-column-title"><div><h3>About PEG</h3></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>What are predicted effector gene lists?</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>Genetic association studies identify genomic regions linked to disease risk and trait variation, but determining which genes are functionally responsible remains a major challenge. Predicted effector gene lists prioritize genes that are likely causal drivers at associated loci using multiple lines of evidence.</p><div class="peg-mini-grid"><div class="peg-mini-card"><strong>Genetic evidence</strong> GWAS signals, fine-mapped variants, coding annotations, and locus-level support.</div><div class="peg-mini-card"><strong>Regulatory evidence</strong> eQTLs, molecular QTLs, chromatin interaction data, and tissue-specific maps.</div><div class="peg-mini-card"><strong>Functional evidence</strong> Functional genomics, perturbation studies, model systems, and integrative prioritization.</div></div></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>How current portal PEG lists work</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>The current portal collection brings together PEG lists curated from the literature and disease-focused studies. Because each source study may use different evidence types, methods, and scoring schemes, list formats can vary across the portal.</p><ul><li>Some lists include top genes only, while others include all genes at loci.</li><li>Some lists provide explicit scores or classifications, while others emphasize evidence summaries.</li><li>The portal makes these heterogeneous resources easier to discover, browse, and interpret.</li></ul></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>Current portal PEG collections</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>The portal currently includes predicted effector gene lists across multiple phenotype groups and physiological systems.</p><div class="peg-plot-wrap"><h4>Current number of predicted effector lists per phenotype group</h4><p><plot><br>{"type":"bar",<br>"data":{"ANTHROPOMETRIC":3,"ATRIAL FIBRILLATION":1,"CARDIOVASCULAR":10,"COVID-19":1,"GLYCEMIC":9,"HEMATOLOGICAL":1,"HEPATIC":2,"IMMUNOLOGICAL":1,"INFLAMMATORY BOWEL":2,"LIPIDS":10, "LUNG": 3,"METABOLITE":2,"MUSCULOSKELETAL":4,"NEUROLOGICAL":3,"OCULAR":3,"OTHER":1,"PSYCHIATRIC":1,"RENAL":5,"REPRODUCTIVE TRAITS":2,"SLEEP AND CIRCADIAN":1,"STROKE":2,"TYPE 1 DIABETES":2},<br>"width":490,<br>"height":200,<br>"color":"multi",<br>"x label angle":65,<br>"label space":140}<br><plot-end></p></div><div class="peg-plot-wrap"><h4>Current number of predicted effector lists per physiological system</h4><p><plot><br>{"type":"bar",<br>"data":{"Cardiovascular":25,"Endocrine":13,"Growth and Development":3,"Immune":5,"Musculoskeletal":4,"Nervous":5, "Renal": 5,"Reproductive":2,"Respiratory":4,"Sensory":3},<br>"width":490,<br>"height":200,<br>"color":"multi",<br>"x label angle":65,<br>"label space":140}<br><plot-end></p></div></div></div></section><section class="peg-column"><div class="peg-column-title"><div><h3>About PEGASUS</h3></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>Why PEGASUS exists</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>Predicted effector gene results are valuable, but they are often difficult to compare across studies because evidence tables, summary lists, metadata, and scoring systems are reported in different ways. PEGASUS was created to support more interoperable and reusable sharing of these resources.</p><p>In other words, PEGASUS is about making future PEG resources easier to exchange and understand, not re-labeling the current portal collection.</p></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>What PEGASUS includes</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>PEGASUS provides a common framework for representing:</p><ul><li>Predicted effector genes</li><li>Associated loci and variants</li><li>Supporting evidence and methods</li><li>Confidence metrics and prioritization scores</li><li>Provenance and study metadata</li></ul><p>This can support more consistent sharing, comparison across studies, and downstream reuse by the research community.</p></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>How PEGASUS fits future submission workflows</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>PEGASUS is intended to support future community-submitted PEG resources. As submission pathways expand, standardized PEGASUS-formatted resources can help the portal ecosystem accept and represent community PEG data more clearly.</p><div class="peg-steps"><div class="peg-step"><span>Step 1</span> Prepare a PEG resource with structured evidence and metadata.</div><div class="peg-step"><span>Step 2</span> Use PEGASUS guidance to organize the resource consistently.</div><div class="peg-step"><span>Step 3</span> Share methods, provenance, and prioritization logic transparently.</div><div class="peg-step"><span>Step 4</span> Support future discoverability and reuse in the KPN ecosystem.</div></div></div></div><div class="peg-accordion"><p><button type="button" onclick="this.closest('.peg-accordion').classList.toggle('is-open'); return false;">
                                                                                                                                                            <span>Learn more and get involved</span>
                                                                                                                                                            <span class="peg-plus">+</span>
                                                                                                                                                          </button></p><div class="peg-accordion-panel"><p>Researchers interested in PEGASUS can review the documentation, read the perspective article, explore the GitHub repository, and contact the Knowledge Portal Network team about collaboration and future submission pathways.</p><div class="peg-link-row"><a href="https://gwas-catalog.github.io/PEGASUS/" target="_blank">PEGASUS documentation</a><br><a href="https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.06.16.731894v3" target="_blank">PEGASUS paper</a><br><a href="https://kpndataregistry.org/peg/login/" target="_blank">Submit PEGASUS data</a><br><a href="/pegasus.html" target="_blank">Explore PEGASUS lists</a><br><a href="mailto:help@kp4cd.org">Contact the PEG team</a></div></div></div></section></div></div></div>
